title: Equivalent Exchange

additional: Minor Silco (Arcane: League of Legends)/Vander (League of Legends)

summary:
No one paid much attention when a young man from the Undercity was expelled from Piltover Academy after having been found to have forged his enrollment.
Significantly more notice is paid five years later, however, when one Jayce Talis is expelled after his trial by the Piltover Council. In this world, there is no keen-eyed assistant to the Dean to read through his notebook and to talk him off the ledge—but something draws him towards Zaun, where he gets his ass kicked and is rescued by an unusual man. Against all odds, Jayce manages to find Viktor anyways.
—
AKA Viktor and Jayce in Zaun, and how that changes the fates of everyone in the two cities.
